Name: Abishai
Summary: Abishai, son of Zeruiah and brother of Joab, was one of David's chief warriors. He went with David into Saul's camp, rescued David from the giant Ishbi-benob, and twice asked to kill Shimei for cursing David. He commanded a third of the army against Absalom.
KeyStory: Abishai stood beside David in Saul's camp, against giants, and against Absalom.
LifeLesson: A brother's loyalty in battle is proven again and again, not once.
